task.title: Install the Node Health Check Operator by using the CLI
task.shortdesc: You can use the OpenShift CLI (oc) to install the Node Health Check Operator.

ul.li: Log in as a user with cluster-admin privileges.

context.p: You can install the Node Health Check Operator in your own namespace or in the openshift-workload-availability namespace.

step.cmd: Create a Namespace custom resource (CR) for the Node Health Check Operator:

substep.cmd: Define the Namespace CR and save the YAML file, for example, node-health-check-namespace.yaml:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: v1 kind: Namespace metadata: name: openshift-workload-availability

substep.cmd: To create the Namespace CR, run the following command:
Define the OperatorGroup CR and save the YAML file, for example, workload-availability-operator-group.yaml:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1 kind: OperatorGroup metadata: name: workload-availability-operator-group namespace: openshift-workload-availability

substep.cmd: To create the OperatorGroup CR, run the following command:
Define the Subscription CR and save the YAML file, for example, node-health-check-subscription.yaml:

info.codeblock: apiVersion: operators.coreos.com/v1alpha1 kind: Subscription metadata: name: node-health-check-operator namespace: openshift-workload-availability spec: channel: stable installPlanApproval: Manual name: node-healthcheck-operator source: redhat-operators sourceNamespace: openshift-marketplace

ul.li: namespace: Specify the Namespace where you want to install the Node Health Check Operator. To install the Node Health Check Operator in the openshift-workload-availability namespace, specify openshift-workload-availability in the Subscription CR.

channel: Specify the channel name for your subscription. To upgrade to the latest version of the Node Health Check Operator, you must manually change the channel name for your subscription from candidate to stable.

installPlanApproval: Set the approval strategy to Manual in case your specified version is superseded by a later version in the catalog. This plan prevents an automatic upgrade to a later version and requires manual approval before the starting CSV can complete the installation.

substep.cmd: To create the Subscription CR, run the following command:

ol.li: Verify that the installation succeeded by inspecting the CSV resource: $ oc get csv -n openshift-workload-availabilityNAME DISPLAY VERSION REPLACES PHASE node-healthcheck-operator.v0.7.0 Node Health Check Operator 0.7.0 node-healthcheck-operator.v0.6.1 Succeeded
Verify that the Node Health Check Operator is up and running: $ oc get deployment -n openshift-workload-availabilityNAME READY UP-TO-DATE AVAILABLE AGE node-healthcheck-controller-manager 2/2 2 2 10d
